title: Enforce memory read and write scope predicates
summary: Enforce stable memory read and write scope predicates so signed memory scopes constrain recent reads, vector search, and intent-result memory writes at dispatch.
expectedFailureModes: A scoped memory read grant can return records from tiers outside the signed scope.
Memory search can return another peer's records or ignore the requested tier scope.
Intent dispatch can write working memory without a compatible memory.write grant.
nextAction: Add read/write scope evaluators, gate recent/search/write paths, keep peer-owned memory isolation, and update capability docs.
